prompts.prompt: In Redis 8.0, the default hash-max-listpack-entries threshold changed from what value to what value? Answer concisely with both numbers.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/redis/references/versions/8.0.md - Encoding threshold changes: hash-max-listpack-entries 128 -> 256 (list, set, and zset listpack thresholds change the same way)

prompts.prompt: In Redis, giving a hash field an expiration with HEXPIRE adds roughly how many extra bytes of memory overhead per expiring field for the expiration metadata? Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/redis/references/versions/7.4.md - Hash Field Expiration > Internal implementation: memory overhead is approximately 16 bytes per expiring field

prompts.prompt: How many hash slots does Redis Cluster use to distribute keys across master nodes? Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/redis/SKILL.md - Clustering Architecture: 16,384 hash slots distributed across master nodes
